children: Cabot has designated Steve Delahunt to step in as interim chief financial officer on Oct. 1, when current finance chief Erica McLaughlin takes the helm of the specialty-chemicals and performance-materials company.

Cabot on Tuesday said Delahunt, currently vice president and corporate treasurer, will serve as interim finance chief while the Boston company continues its search for a permanent successor to McLaughlin.
Cabot in July said McLaughlin, who joined the company in 2002 and has been finance chief since May 2018, would succeed Sean Keohane as president and chief executive.
